content: Canvas-to-video: WebCodecs VideoEncoder + a muxer (mediabunny 1.61.4, or deprecated mp4-muxer) gives deterministic frame-by-frame encoding independent of wall clock - best for offline render. MediaRecorder is realtime-only and drops frames. Puppeteer/Playwright headless capture alternates. Simplest path: render frame, VideoFrame(canvas), encoder.encode(), mux to MP4.
